title: erodium cicutarium var. allotrichum
intro: Erodium cicutarium var. allotrichum, commonly known as Redstem Storksbill, is a plant species belonging to the Geraniaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe wounds and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Erodium cicutarium var. allotrichum include antiseptic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can aid in the treatment of skin infections, fever, and inflammation-related disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
